method: Cold replay each original fixture with byte-identical ROM hash and published input sequences. No isolated-AI fixture substitution and no runtime-memory writes.
After every emulated frame read all4 Kirby rooms/abilities using base0x02020EE0,stride0x1A8,room+0x60,ability+0x103. Preserve change-log for all frames including startup.

For Box Boxer, identify runtime object by template0x088BF7E4. Read signed16-bit HP at+0x80 each frame. At every decrease read attack pointer base.unk6C(+0x6C), attack kind/room/damage/parent/kirby2 and allKirbys.

Source-verified ObjectBase parent offset0x70 and kirby2 offset0x74, size0x78 (include/data.h). The Magic cross-room effect explicitly stores its caster in kirby2 (src/code_0806F780.c sub_080838DC/sub_08083B04).

No AI ever heldCook12,Magic21,Crash24 in these exact replays. Carrier audits also found no AI in the same room asP1 after startup. This rules out the specifically identified off-room Magic assistance, rather than treating off-room placement alone as isolation.

100.result: All live HP losses have P1-owned effects and no foreign caster. Published health/equipment/check result reproduced.
